title: 行山嗰個阿伯
mood: being noticed by exactly one person
subject: three years of saying good morning to the same man on the same trail
caption: Cantonese folk punk. Steel-string acoustic guitar strummed fast and hard with the pick noise and body thump left in, mandolin tremolo doubling the melody, driving snare on every backbeat with a marching feel, electric bass running eighth notes, a single fiddle line in the bridge. Raw and fast with the acoustic instruments pushed into mild distortion and the mix left rough. Male voice, shouted and breathless, slightly off-pitch on purpose, with gang vocals on the chorus. 160 BPM, D major. Being noticed by exactly one person. No synth, no drum machine, no autotune, no ballad section, no key change.
lyrics:
[Verse]
我行咗三年 每個禮拜六 同一條路
每次都遇到同一個阿伯 佢行落 我行上
佢永遠著返件藍色背心 永遠拎支膠樽
佢永遠同我講「早晨」 我永遠都答「早晨」

[Chorus]
三年 一百五十次「早晨」
我唔知佢姓咩 佢唔知我姓咩
但如果有一日我冇出現 佢會知
呢個世界上知我唔見咗嘅人 冇幾個

[Verse]
上個月我拗柴 兩個禮拜冇行
返嚟嗰日 佢停低咗
佢話「你去咗邊」 四個字
我答唔出 我企喺度 好似等咗好耐先等到

[Chorus]
三年 一百五十次「早晨」
我唔知佢姓咩 佢唔知我姓咩
但如果有一日我冇出現 佢會知
呢個世界上會發現我唔見咗嘅人 原來多咗一個

[Outro]
下個禮拜六
我一定去
